  • Token counts: 105 light (:root) · 105 dark ([data-theme="dark"]) · 105 distinct names

1. The canonical layer stack

Values flow in exactly one direction. Reach for the highest layer that can express what you need.

  1. CSS custom properties — apps/web/src/styles/globals.css. Light values live on :root; dark values override on [data-theme="dark"]. This is the only place a raw hex/rgba belongs.
  2. Tailwind semantic mapping — apps/web/tailwind.config.ts maps those variables to named tokens (bg-primary, text-text-2, border-border-strong, shadow-card, rounded-lg, font-display…). Dark mode is darkMode: ["selector", "[data-theme='dark'], so dark: variants key off the same data attribute.
  3. cva primitives — apps/web/src/components/ui/*. button.tsx is the model: every visual decision is a named variant, and consumers pick a variant rather than restyling.
  4. Shared class constants — apps/web/src/lib/styles/styleClasses.ts for repeated multi-class recipes (card padding, transitions, interactive states).
  5. Component-local classes — last resort, and only from tokens.

2. Usage rules

  • DO use the named tailwind token: bg-primary, text-text-3, border-border-strong, bg-sg-3, shadow-card.
  • DON'T write arbitrary-value escapes for tokens that already have a name — bg-[var(--primary)] is the same pixel as bg-primary but it hides the token from grep and from the config. Arbitrary values are legitimate only for variables the config does not map (see the “Tailwind token” column — rows marked — genuinely require var(), e.g. bg-[var(--card-glass)], border-[var(--border-default)]).
  • NEVER hardcode a hex or rgba in a component. If a colour does not exist as a token, add it to both theme blocks in globals.css first.
  • Theme selector: dark mode is [data-theme="dark"] on <html>, set by next-themes (attribute="data-theme"). There is no .dark class and no .light class — a selector like .light .pill never matches.
  • Fonts: font-display (Nunito) for headings, numerals, buttons and pills — anything with weight ≥ 700. font-sans (Plus Jakarta Sans) is the body default, already applied on <body>, so only re-declare it to undo a display context. font-mono (JetBrains Mono) for code, addresses, hashes and any tabular figure.
  • Solana gradient: --sol-grad / bg-cert-gradient is a brand accent used across certificates, mastery bars, deploy CTAs and marketing surfaces. It is not certificate-only — but it is never a background for body text.
  • New tokens must be added to both :root and [data-theme="dark"], then mapped in tailwind.config.ts, then regenerated here.

4. Typography

Fonts are self-hosted through next/font/google in apps/web/src/app/layout.tsx — no runtime Google Fonts request, which is why the CSP does not allow fonts.googleapis.com. This page deliberately loads no webfonts either; if a family is not installed locally you will see the fallback, but the stack and weights below are exact.

RoleFamilyCSS variableTailwindWeights loadeddisplay
fontSansPlus Jakarta Sans--font-sansfont-sans font-body400, 500, 600, 700swap
fontDisplayNunito--font-displayfont-display600, 700, 800, 900swap
fontMonoJetBrains Mono--font-monofont-monodefault—

The <body> element carries ${fontSans.variable} ${fontDisplay.variable} ${fontMono.variable} overflow-x-clip font-sans antialiased. Base type is set in globals.css: font-size: 14px, line-height: 1.6, -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased. There is no global heading scale — headings size themselves with tailwind utilities per surface (e.g. CardTitle = font-display text-2xl font-extrabold leading-none tracking-tight).

5. Radii, shadows & motion

Radii and shadows are tokens first, tailwind utilities second — see the “Radii” and “Shadows” tables above for live values. The tailwind mapping is:

Tailwind utilityResolves to
rounded-smvar(--r-sm)
rounded-mdvar(--r-md)
rounded-lgvar(--r-lg)
rounded-xlvar(--r-xl)
shadow-pushvar(--shadow-push-color)
shadow-push-smvar(--shadow-push-color)
shadow-push-activevar(--shadow-push-color)
shadow-cardvar(--shadow-card)
shadow-card-hovervar(--shadow-card-hover)
shadow-glowvar(--shadow-glow)
shadow-glow-xpvar(--shadow-glow-xp)
shadow-certvar(--shadow-cert)
shadow-cert-hovervar(--shadow-cert-hover)
shadow-cert-lgvar(--shadow-cert-lg)

shadow-push / shadow-push-sm / shadow-push-active compose --shadow-push-color into the 3D press effect used by the button primitive; the pressed state is active:translate-y-[2px] plus the shorter shadow.

Card (apps/web/src/components/ui/card.tsx)

Card is static by design — rounded-[var(--r-lg)] border border-[var(--border-default)] bg-[var(--card)] text-[var(--text)] shadow-[var(--shadow-card)]. Interactive cards opt into the hover lift via styleClasses (CARD_STYLES.containerHover / INTERACTIVE_STATES.hoverLift). CardHeader/CardContent/CardFooter are p-6 (content and footer pt-0); CardTitle is font-display text-2xl font-extrabold; CardDescription is text-sm text-text-2. The chunkier .card-chunky class in globals.css is the marketing/dashboard variant.

Pills (globals.css)

Pills are plain CSS classes, not a cva primitive: .pill plus one of .pill-beg .pill-int .pill-adv .pill-xp .pill-streak .pill-level .pill-sol .pill-done (.pill-primary aliases .pill-beg). Base geometry: 4px 12px padding, var(--r-full), display font, 700 weight, 11px, uppercase, 0.4px tracking, 1px border.

7. Retheming checklist

  1. Edit the hex/rgba in :root and [data-theme="dark"] in apps/web/src/styles/globals.css. Both blocks must stay name-for-name identical.
  2. Only add to apps/web/tailwind.config.ts if you introduced a new variable that deserves a semantic class.
  3. Four surfaces sit outside the CSS-variable pipeline and must be updated by hand: the Monaco editor themes (apps/web/src/components/editor/themes.ts), the transactional email templates (apps/web/src/lib/email/templates.ts — mail clients do not support custom properties), third-party brand marks (apps/web/src/components/icons/*), and canvas/SVG literals in a handful of landing and dashboard components.
  4. Regenerate this page and diff it: the diff is the change log for the design system.
